caption: The three DFA states of the worked example, each one a set of NFA states: A = {q0} is the start, and C = {q0,q2} is final because it holds q2. Read the labels on the arrows to check the table: A on b stays at A, B on b goes to C, and C on b comes back to A, so the machine accepts exactly the strings ending in ab.

spec.title: Subset construction: A={q0}, B={q0,q1}, C={q0,q2}
spec.aria: A three-state DFA with start state A = {q0} and final state C = {q0,q2}, joined by six labelled transitions: A on a to B, A on b to A, B on a to B, B on b to C, C on a to B, and C on b to A.
